snippet.title: Puzzlegeddon - Gameplay footage #1
snippet.description:
Gameplay footage of Pieces Interactive team playing Puzzlegeddon.

Puzzlegeddon is a puzzle brawler for PC with online multiplayer support for up to 6 players.
Release date: Nov 27, 2008
